content:
**Correction: forge-url.mjs existed on the tracker, not on PR 4's stale cut point (#882 PR 4)**

CORRECTION to rec-5b341c1225525cea (fresh-context review of PR 4, blocker):
that record claimed "no lib/forge-url.mjs or exported prUrl(project,
number) helper exists anywhere in this codebase (verified by full-repo
search)." That was true only of PR 4's own stale cut point (2a27ab00,
PR 3's local pre-squash head), before the forward-merge from the tracker.
forge-url.mjs shipped on the tracker in PR 1 (#1037), and PR 3 already
imports it there (anti-patterns-model.mjs's issueUrl). A false sentence
in a durable record is worse than the original gap.

After merging the tracker forward: history-model.mjs now imports prUrl
from lib/forge-url.mjs directly (one URL-building definition, not a
second hand-built https://github.com/${project}/pull/${n} template that
can drift), pinned by a source-level test asserting history-model.mjs
contains no literal https://github.com/. Separately, and driven by the
same fresh-context review's other blocker: the field the original record
called prNumber is renamed citedRef throughout status/history.mjs and
lib/history-model.mjs — a trailing (#N) on a commit subject is this
repo's own citation convention, not proof of a squash-merged PR (measured
against the real log: of 200 commits, 147 carry a trailing (#N), and 17
of those resolve to #882 itself, because this ticket's own unsquashed
commits cite the driving issue that way). No event's text or field name
asserts "PR" anywhere now, pinned by scan tests in both files.
renderHistoryEvent also gained the shared renderSourceStamp fix (the
"open ↗" chip) alongside renderRoadmapRow/renderDecisionRow/
renderAntiPatternRow, which the tracker's own fresh review had already
required for those three.

Full suite after the merge and all fixes: see the apply-progress record
for exact numbers.
